correctness.rationale: For each unit x, dihedral transitivity reduces to an edge interior x=(a,1-a) or vertex x=(1,0). For an edge, unique norming functional s+t forces y=±(phi,-phi); exact evaluation gives A=2r+r²a and B=phi-r²a. For a vertex, the norming functionals s+t and s+rt force the opposite edge y=(1+r theta,-phi) up to sign, with identical affine A,B expressions. Since A+B=2r+phi=(3sqrt5-1)/2 for every pair, min<=half<=max, and a=1/2 attains both, giving J_perp=g_perp=(3sqrt5-1)/4. Independently evaluated the branches at five non-grid rational parameters including endpoints and checked the active-functional products; actual verify.py uses exact Q(sqrt5) arithmetic on parameter grids, corroborative only.
